scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/mcp && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/sync-separation.mjs --check && npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli
scripts.publish:all: npm run build && npm publish -w packages/shared --access public && npm publish -w packages/mcp --access public && npm publish -w packages/cli --access public
